target.statement: At N=1 (single honest run), the fraction of UCR Anomaly Archive series on which a pure no-skill detector reaches ≥90% of the SOTA reference is 0.11 for affiliation-F1 (Table 2, row affiliation-F1, column rate @N=1).
target.dataset: UCR Anomaly Archive (250 univariate series, cropped to 40k points)

compute.basis: Requires re-implementing the full pipeline (six real detectors, 41 no-skill attempts, affiliation metric, SOTA reference) from scratch since no code link is given; UCR data is public but large (250 series, up to 900k points, cropped to 40k), and affiliation computation over 250 series × 41 attempts × 15 thresholds is CPU-heavy but feasible in a few hours.

blockers: No code link in the PDF; harness is only 'provided with this submission as supplementary material', not publicly linked
Must re-implement six real detectors (Matrix Profile, Isolation Forest, LOF, PCA, kNN, AR) and the affiliation metric from authors' frozen commits
UCR Anomaly Archive download and preprocessing (cropping, deduplication) must be replicated
title: Did We Actually Fix It? An Independent Adversarial Stress-Test of Post-Point-Adjustment Evaluation Metrics for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
